principles: Local-first capture: Track Job must write to Chrome local storage before any network call.
Durable state: every tracked job has local sync metadata: pending, synced, or failed.
Idempotent server writes: dashboard sync merges by normalized job URL before writing.
Basic sync is free: dashboard sync is not Pro gated.
Recoverable failures stay local and retryable.
Every fallback or failure emits a structured diagnostic log.

states.pending: Saved locally and waiting for dashboard sync.
states.synced: Saved locally and last dashboard sync completed.
states.failed: Saved locally but last dashboard sync failed.

adminRules: Admin panel should show persisted operational logs when available.
Admin panel can fall back to computed signals when no persisted logs exist yet.
Admin UI must not reveal admin email or private auth details.
